hook: → 覆盖相关(CRWD/PANW/FTNT)：AI 自动化攻击浪潮对网络安全平台化整合的影响
lines: The traditional security "Pyramid of Pain" has collapsed as autonomous AI agents democratize nation-state-level attack capabilities, collapsing sophisticated breaches into automated routines.

Organizations face a critical "break or breach" dilemma where skyrocketing Common Vulnerability Exposures force a choice between catastrophic system downtime from rapid patching or leaving assets exposed.
AI-driven attack frameworks can chain dozens of ignored low-risk vulnerabilities into high-impact remote code execution, rendering traditional risk-prioritization models obsolete.

Sophisticated state actors are bypassing technical perimeters by infiltrating enterprises as remote employees, driving an urgent shift toward multi-layered identity verification and local AI sovereignty.
title: CrowdStrike CEO: AI Cyberattack Wave, Hyperspeed Hacks, & The Patching Problem
